name: Premium Group Co Ltd
summary: Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Premium Group Co., Ltd. was established in 2007 and specializes in delivering diverse financial and service solutions primarily within the automotive sector. The company's business activities are structured across three key divisions: Finance, Automobile Warranty, and Automotive Mobility Services. Within its Finance segment, Premium Group offers comprehensive services such as vehicle leasing, debt collection, salvaging, and various financing options. The Automobile Warranty division focuses on vehicle inspections, repairs, maintenance, bodywork, paintwork, and the development and sale of warranty products. Furthermore, the company extends its offerings to include consultancy services, the distribution and rental of Internet of Things (IoT) devices, and the creation of specialized software for managing car sales.
